job.question: In the Boston Retirement System's investment consulting services proposal questionnaire (Attachment 3), how many current public fund client references must be listed, and what minimum asset size must those clients have?
job.expected_facts: Up to 10 current public fund clients with assets greater than $1 billion for whom similar work was performed, giving name, contact, telephone number, asset values, number of years the client has retained the firm and the service used.
job.acceptance: Accept up to ten / no more than ten and >$1bn. Contact-detail fields and similar-work context are supplementary; exactly ten or at least $1bn is not equivalent.

reviews.reason: This is a San Francisco Employees’ Retirement System RFP with Appendix A, not the Boston Retirement System’s Attachment 3 questionnaire. Its reference requirement is at least five existing clients and states no greater-than-$1-billion asset threshold; it does not support the requested facts.
quotes: Request for Proposals for General Investment Consulting Services for the City and County of San Francisco Employees’ Retirement System

Provide the organization name, address, contact name and title, contact telephone number and email address for at least five existing clients. Indicate the length of your relationship, nature of the services provided, and asset size for each reference.
